name: Dead Zone
source:
Set far into the future of "Blackened Death", four very unlucky young men encounter a huge Norwegian dude and his backpack girlfriend.

[From [url=https://waywardvoidgod.itch.io/dead-zone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事设定在《焦黑之死》遥远的未来，四个倒霉透顶的年轻人遇上了一名身材魁梧的挪威大汉和他的背包女友。

[摘自[url=https://waywardvoidgod.itch.io/dead-zone]Itch.io[/url]]
